title: HarmQ: Harmonic Backdoor Attacks Against Quantum Neural Networks
summary: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for quantum machine learning in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, leveraging quantum phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to process information in exponentially large Hilbert spaces. However, QNNs inherit critical security vulnerabilities from classical neural networks, particularly susceptibility to backdoor attacks.
